messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: SALESFORCE tenant SLA breach - 5xx-rate > 5% (5m) -> pager duty triggered (#PD-9982) https://dash.redwood.local/d/tenants/errors?var-tenant=salesforce
Ava: ack, I'm on it. grabbing logs + traffic heatmap. starting triage.
Diego: I can help with logs and traces. any known deploys in the last 24h?
Ava: last model shard rollout was ~12h ago, but infra deploys were 2d ago. initial glance: spike in upstream 502/504 from inference-worker pool.
Sonia: FYI: we're seeing a lot of noisy alerts from the per-tenant check lately. SalesForce is particularly chatty during business hours. might be a false-positive amplification.
Evans: can we silence at tenant-level briefly while we triage? don't want to drown SRE paging.
Ava: yes please. temporary silence for tenant=salesforce for 30m. leave global alerting intact.
Evans: doing it now.
Evans: command I used (Alertmanager API):
```
curl -s -XPOST "https://alertmanager.internal/api/v2/silences" -d '{
  "matchers": [{"name": "tenant", "value": "salesforce", "isRegex": false}],
  "startsAt": "2027-04-15T15:12:00Z",
  "endsAt": "2027-04-15T15:42:00Z",
  "createdBy": "Evans",
  "comment": "temporary suppression: noisy tenant-specific SLA during active mitigation"
}'
```
Ava: confirmed silence created, silence id 3f9c. Thank you. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: PD incident PD-9982 acknowledged by Ava (oncall). Handoff ETA 12:00 UTC.
Diego: pulled PromQL to validate per-tenant 5xx ratio:
```
100 * sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="proxy",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (tenant)
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="proxy"}[5m])) by (tenant)
```
Diego: running query for salesforce -> shows 5xx ratio ~6.8% at peak, but total traffic also 2.1k rps so a small absolute error volume.
Ava: interesting — high ratio but small absolute. Could be a malformed request pattern from their integration. check top endpoints.
Sonia: New dashboard panel proposal: per-tenant 5xx %, 5xx count, p95 latency, and top-10 source IPs. I'll add tile and share link.
Sonia: adding panel now -> https://dash.redwood.local/d/tenants/salesforce-inspect (wip)
Evans: also adding a dedupe route in Alertmanager to group by ['tenant','alertname'] to reduce duplicate pages when downstream has transient retries. Will push change to staging first.
Ava: For immediate mitigation we should also throttle customer-specific health-check alerts (heartbeat-check) to require 2 consecutive evaluation windows (5m) before paging. i.e. change for tenant-scoped rule only.
Diego: I can submit the PR for the alert rule change. Proposed change snippet:
```
- alert: TenantSLAHigh5xx
  expr: >-
    100 * sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="proxy",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (tenant)
    / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="proxy"}[5m])) by (tenant) > 5
  for: 0m
+ for: 10m  # require sustained 2 windows (5m each) before firing
```
Diego: will target staging, verify noise drops.
Ava: yes, do staging -> smoke dashboards -> prod. keep the existing global SLA rule untouched.
Sonia: documenting suggested thresholds in the ticket.
Evans: small mitigation done: added a temporary alertmanager route to continue matching and dedupe alerts, pushed to prod. monitoring noise now.
Ava: Confirmed immediate reduction in duplicate pages. still seeing real errors but fewer PD wakeups.
Diego: From logs: many errors are `invalid_chunk: tokenization_error` coming from a subset of requests with long input vectors from salesforce webhook. I suspect a client-side integration bug.
Sonia: can we rate-limit large payloads per-tenant as a short-term protective measure?
Ava: good idea. we have a per-tenant request-size gate in the proxy, can lower limit for salesforce to 256KB and add a soft-fail path returning 413 + structured error advising client. Do we want to do that now?
Evans: I can flip the config flag and target a canary subset of their traffic (5% traffic) first.
Ava: proceed. keep audit logs and notify support.
Evans: config change pushed to canary -> salesforce canary shows reduced 5xx by 60% on that slice. rolling to 100% in 5m.
Ava: good. ticket being created: CH-2217 (salesforce noisy SLA + mitigation). I'll own follow-up tasks: root cause, customer outreach, runbook update.
Sonia: runbook action items to add after-action section: `per-tenant-silence`, `alert-forcing-duration`, and `per-tenant-rate-limits` with sample Alertmanager/Prometheus snippets.
Diego: leaving some follow-ups for postmortem: evaluate changing SLA threshold from 5% -> 7% for low-volume tenants (traffic < 5 rps) to avoid noisy pages for small customers.
Ava: agreed — need clear rule: if tenant_traffic_qps < X then require longer `for:` or higher threshold. put in Optimize backlog.
ops-bot: Note: next oncall handoff at 2027-04-15T16:00Z, current lead Ava handing to Diego for 2h follow-up.
Ava: handing to Diego now. Diego, please ensure the silence is removed if we see sustained real impact, and follow up with support for customer messaging.
Diego: got it. I'll re-open PD if errors spike after unmute.
Evans: creating follow-up infra ticket INF-534 to add a tenant-scoped dedupe policy and a heartbeat toggle in the console (so support can mute at tenant level without engineering).
Sonia: adding dashboard screenshots and sample queries to CH-2217.
Ava: Thanks team. After-action: update runbook, add the per-tenant PromQL snippet, and schedule a 30m postmortem with product + support. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: PD incident PD-9982 resolved (silenced + mitigations in place).
Diego: will patrol the dashboards for the next hour. leaving notes in CH-2217.
Ava: closing thread for live mitigation. Postmortem + runbook edits due EOD tomorrow.
